634A.summary_en: LAYERED Inc. provides medical digital transformation (DX) services. The company offers products, such as Kakarite, a patient management and communication support system; and Medical Window, medical information media; and services, including website production and operation support for medical institutions. The company serves clinics, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, and local governments. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

627A.summary_en: akippa Inc. owns and operates an online marketplace for vacant car parking space reservation and rental. Its platform offers a smart parking experience to park a car anywhere in the city. akippa Inc. was formerly known as Galaxy Agency Inc. and changed its name to akippa Inc. in February 2015. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

623A.summary_en: Vertex Co., Ltd. provides real estate services in Japan. It offers real estate consulting, real estate planning and development, real estate sales, rental brokerage, and property management services. The company also involves in business of real estate fund and non-life insurance agency, as well as business related to the solicitation of life insurance. Vertex Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

622A.summary_en: Techno Craft Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells IT solutions in Japan. The company offers products, such as GPS-based cart navigation and fleet management systems for golf courses under the Marshal-Ai brand, a cloud-based business support system for childcare facilities named Commu-Navi, and health monitoring solutions using GPS technology; and services, including application development, ASP services, and support for its various control terminals. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Niigata-shi, Japan.

625A.summary_en: Skyfall Inc. provides digital marketing and advertising technology (AdTech) services in Japan. The company offers services, such as marketing support and media platform development, to connect users with products and services and support the growth of partner companies. It products includes SKYFLAG, a reward marketing platform designed to enhance the user experience and drive service engagement; Poker Chase, a battle royale-style Texas Hold'em poker game; POCKET PLAY, a rewards app that lets users earn points simply by playing their favorite games; and SKYORDER, a self-ordering system for restaurants that goes beyond streamlining operations. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

621A.summary_en: Audiostock Inc. owns and operates an online community platform where music creators can present and share their music audios. The company offers a platform for music creators to register their music and sell usage rights, receiving royalties based on sales. It also provides a marketplace for music creators to sell their work and for users to purchase licenses. Audiostock Inc. was formerly known as CreoFuga, Inc. and changed its name to Audiostock Inc. in July 2020. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Okayama, Japan.

619A.summary_en: Oliver Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells interior design products in Japan. The company offers task chairs, desks, sofas, lobby chairs, tables, outdoor furniture, cabinets, executive and reception furniture, kids' furniture, private booths, and other equipment. It caters to hotels, offices, restaurants, and commercial and medical facilities. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Okazaki, Japan.

618A.summary_en: KOMPEITO Inc. engages in the operation of an employee-benefit food service in Japan. The company offers OFFICE DE YASAI, a refrigerator that delivers fresh vegetables; OFFICE DE MEDIA, a digital signage displays product information for OFFICE DE YASAI, as well as TV commercials, weather forecasts, and other content; and SALAD STAND, a salad vending machine that helps to reduce food waste. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

The company's platforms include Delish Kitchen, which delivers recipe videos; retail HUB, including Store DX, which involves installing digital signage in retail stores; Tomonite, which helps with child-rearing; and MOMENTH, which offers services that address companies' marketing challenges. It also offers tie-up advertising, display ads, store vision ads, user matching ads, performance-based advertising, and ad network advertising. every,Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

The construction business focuses on maintenance and inspection work for nuclear power plants; The renewable energy business focuses on development, construction, and maintenance of renewable energy. It also engages in day care service for the elderly, gym services, and restaurant services. In addition, the company engages in electricity retail business. beABLE CO.,LTD. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Futaba, Japan.

603A.summary_en: i GRID SOLUTIONS Inc. develops and operates platforms that enable the integrated utilization of distributed energy resources in Japan. It operates through GX Solution Business and Energy Trading Business segments. It also provides various services related to promoting green transformation, including battery storage and EV-related services; and offers energy trading services for the use and circulation of renewable energy resources. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

593A.summary_en: Tier IV, Inc. develops open-source software solutions for autonomous driving. It develops Autoware, which is a software for urban driverless cars and supports 3D localization, object detection, path planning and following, and lane detection. In addition, the company offers self-driving development kit; autoware loggers; and autoware remove drive kit. It also offers sensor fusion technologies and products, including laser scanners and cameras. It also offers mobility services, development services, and solution services, covering deployment of autonomous driving systems, system integration, testing, operation support, and maintenance. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

598A.summary_en: ChatPlus Co.,Ltd. develops and provides SaaS-based subscription-based chatbot systems in Japan. The chatbot system is a service that supports companies in improving operational efficiency and productivity by automating and reducing the manpower required to handle inquiries from both inside and outside the company. It offers ChatPlus, a chatbot that supports the automation of corporate inquiry handling and communication, employing a format; AI Agent Plus, a chatbot that integrates generation AI such as ChatCPT with Chat Plus to generate optimal responses on the spot in addition to registered answers, enabling it to handle complex inquiries and diverse expressions from visitors and provide natural conversational responses; and FAQPlus, a system for creating, organizing, and managing articles of frequently asked questions and answers, so that users can easily find the answers they need. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

590A.summary_en: giftee Group, Inc. engages in the creation, distribution, and sale of e-gifts. It sells its e-gifts online via smartphones and other devices. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. NEIS Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Minami no Shima Co., Ltd.

Its products include LabHub, a platform which supports productivity improvement for researchers, including pharmaceutical companies; and shikAI, a navigation system for the visually impaired, as a social contribution project. The company was formerly known as Links Co., Ltd. and changed its name to LiNKX, Inc. in November 2025. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

581A.summary_en: GO Inc. designs and develops a taxi-hailing application that enables users to arrange and schedule a cab ride in Japan. The company's application offers real-time location information sharing, digitalization of operations for taxi companies, management service, and decarbonization services. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

575A.summary_en: MAEZAWA Holdings CO.,LTD., through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of water supply and sewage-related products. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Umenoyado Brewery Co., Ltd. was founded in 1893 and is headquartered in Katsuragi, Japan.

The company was founded in 1974 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.

SEIWA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells highway signs; and fabricates inspection lanes and steel brackets. It offers customer data integration solution for corporate activities including marketing and management. The company was formerly known as Landscape Co., Ltd. and changed its name to uSonar Co., Ltd. in July 2022. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Shinjuku, Japan.

429A.summary_en: Tekscend Photomask Corp. manufactures and distributes semiconductor photomasks in Japan, China, Taiwan, South Korea, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It offers photomasks, including binary and phase shift masks, and EUV photomasks; 3D photomasks; and silicon stencil masks/molds for nanoimprint, including quartz and silicon molds. It also photomasks for various applications, such as MEMS, semiconductor packaging substrates, LED, tool accuracy control, high resolution printing, IC bump packaging, micro lens array, thermal head, and OEM qualification and research. Tekscend Photomask Corp. was formerly known as Toppan Photomask Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tekscend Photomask Corp. in October 2024. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

423A.summary_en: Lion Office Products Corp. is a global company that specializes in the production and distribution of various office products, including NT cutters, NT spare blades, OHTO writing instruments, and Lion office products. It also offers cutting mats, rulers, rulers for aluminum cutting rulers, scissors, staplers, staples, and tally counters. In addition, the company provides Yamato glue sticks, sticky roll paper tapes, and Yamata liquid glue sticks. Additionally, it offers a variety of writing instruments, such as stylus pens, stylus pencils, and stylus erasers. The company was founded in 1792 and is based in Higashiosaka, Japan.

428A.summary_en: Cypress Holdings Co., Ltd. operates and manages a food store that offers various Japanese food brands in Japan. The company provides seafood, sushi, yakitori, noodles, fast food, western food, Chinese food, and cafes. It offers its products under the Tsukiji Shokudo Genchan brand name. Cypress Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Minato, Japan.

421A.summary_en: Movin' Strategic Career CO., LTD. provides paid employment placement services. The company offers recruitment services to consulting firms and other professional firms; career planning support for businesspeople through various media; and executive search and recruitment assistance to companies and job seekers. Movin' Strategic Career CO., LTD. was formerly known as Predecessor Movin Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Minato, Japan.

414A.summary_en: OVERLAP Holdings,Inc. engages in the planning, production, and sale of entertainment IP contents of manga, novels, comics, and animations. It is also involved in the cross-media development and licensing business. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Shinagawa, Japan.

417A.summary_en: Blue Zones Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the operation of supermarkets in Japan. The company offers various products, including fresh food, dried and processed food, and daily food, as well as delicatessen products. It also engages in the trading business and related operations; store-related services such as security, facility management, insurance agency; import and wholesale of food products, beverages, alcohol, and raw materials; and assisting with food manufacturing, processing, and packaging, and other related tasks. The company was formerly known as Yaoko Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Blue Zones Holdings Co.,Ltd. in October 2025. was founded in 1890 and is headquartered in Kawagoe, Japan.

416A.summary_en: Fuji United Holdings Company,Ltd. purchases and sells petroleum products in Japan. The company operates through the Oil Business, Recycling Business, Renewable Energy Business, Home Energy Business, and Rental Business segments. It offers biodiesel fuels, recycled heavy oil, carbon offset fuels, fuel oils, asphalts, and lubricants, as well as AdBlue, a urea water for ammonia-based exhaust gas purification systems. The company also collects, transports, and processes industrial waste, as well as manufactures and sells recycled heavy oil; sells electricity generated by solar power plants; sells household fuel in small lots; and rents construction machinery and other equipment. Fuji United Holdings Company,Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

415A.summary_en: GMO TECH Holdings, Inc. operates as a holding company that engages in internet advertising, real estate tech, affiliate services, internet media, GMO and DX solutions businesses. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.

8729.summary_en: Sony Financial Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in Japan. It offers death protection, medical, educational endowment, living benefit, automobile, medical, overseas travel, and fire insurance products, as well as reinsurance services. The company also provides foreign currency deposits, mortgage loans, investment trust, and venture capital and credit card settlement services, as well as plans, develops, and operates nursing care homes. Sony Financial Group Inc. was formerly known as Sony Financial Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Sony Financial Group Inc. in October 2021. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

407A.summary_en: Unicon Holdings Co., Ltd. provides construction and related business services. It engages in the civil engineering and building construction activities. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in Sendai, Japan.

410A.summary_en: GMO Commerce, Inc. provides marketing support for e-commerce and brick-and-mortar stores. It also develops and provides marketing platforms that support the improvement of store CX and the promotion of DX. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Tokyo, Japan with an additional office in Miyazaki, Japan. GMO Commerce, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of GMO internet group, Inc.

409A.summary_en: Orion Breweries, Ltd. manufactures and sells alcohol and soft drinks in Japan. The company also engages in the operation of hotels and facilities. In addition, it owns, rents, and manages tourist properties. It sells its beer under the Orion brand name. The company was formerly known as Okinawa Breweries, Ltd. and changed its name to Orion Breweries, Ltd. In January 1959. The company was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Tomigusuku, Japan.

402A.summary_en: Axelspace Holdings Corporation designs, manufactures, operates, and sells micro-satellites and related components in Japan and internationally. It offers AxelGlobe, an Earth observation platform that offers business insights for various applications, including agriculture, disaster monitoring, news reporting, and environmental management; and AxelLiner, a one-stop service for satellite projects to conduct space missions including observations, communications, experiments, and in-orbit demonstrations. Axelspace Holdings Corporation has a strategic partnership with Airbus Defence and Space SAS to develop and deliver solutions that meet long-term customer needs for utilizing satellite imagery. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

387A.summary_en: Fuller, Inc. offers business development and digital consultancy services in Japan. The company develops applications for mobile devices and offers App Ape, an app analytics service that provides the actual usage application data of smartphones. It also offers services, such as app development, UI/UX design, system development, and application usage data analysis with a focus on smartphone applications, and human resource development support. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.

386A.summary_en: Minoya Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of confectionery products through retail stores under the Okashino Machioka name. It offers various sweets, pastries, snacks, rice crackers, and biscuits. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Saitama, Japan.

378A.summary_en: Hit Co., Ltd., an advertising company, engages in outdoor and transit advertising business. The company is involved in planning, researching, constructing and maintaining sign. It also offers HIT-movi, a smartphone location-based advertising service that is linked to the placement of outdoor advertisements, as well as developing synchronized broadcasting media that allows multiple large-scale vision to be displayed, as well as planning and producing advertising videos for digital media. The company offers digital billboards in the areas of shibuya / omotesando / ikebukuro / miyamasu / ebisu-bashi / metropolitan expressway; and static billboards in the areas of metropolitan expressway / shibuya / downtown / roadside / others. Hit Co., Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

373A.summary_en: LIPPS Co.,Ltd. develops and sells men's beauty products. It offers haircare, skincare, and makeup products. The company also operates hair salons under the LIPPS franchise. It sells its products online. LIPPS Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

372A.summary_en: Rent Corporation engages in the rental of construction and industrial machinery. The company rents industrial vehicles, passenger cars, industrial machinery and equipment, and construction machinery and equipment; inspects and calibrates measuring tools, lifting equipment, etc.; provides cleaning and packaging services for equipment used in clean rooms; and remanufacturers batteries. It is also involved in the rental car franchise, construction and industrial machinery training, and painting rental businesses. Rent Corporation was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.

369A.summary_en: A-tie Co.,Ltd. engages in grave construction and management business. The company plans, designs, and constructs tree burials/permanent memorial graves and cemeteries. It also offers customer acquisition and sales agency services for cemetery users; and temple management consulting services. A-tie Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

368A.summary_en: Kitazato Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, and markets medical devices, reagents, and related products for fertility treatment. It offers needles, catheters and cannulas, vitrification media and equipment, sperm processing medium/tools, IVF medium products, micro tools, and labware products. The company was formerly known as Kitazato Biopharma Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Shizuoka, Japan. Kitazato Corporation is a subsidiary of Kitasato Shoji Co., Ltd.

367A.summary_en: Primo Global Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the bridal jewelry business in Japan, Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Singapore. It sells and purchases bridal jewelry under the I-PRIMO and LAZARE DIAMOND brand names through its stores. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

366A.summary_en: Wellness Communications Corporation provides healthcare data platform and solutions. The company provides Growbase, a cloud-based health management system that promotes health management operations and health focused management through centralized management of health data; health checkup solution, a network medical checkup service handles health checkup related tasks; SUZAKU, a talent management and human resource management system based on organizational psychology and AI; and other medical institution support services. It also offers wellness-related information distribution and service introduction business; and occupational health services. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

365A.summary_en: Izawa Towel Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, manufacturing, import/export, and sales of towel products in Japan. The company offers its products under the Towel Research Institute brand name. It serves convenience stores, entertainment companies, e-commerce businesses, discount stores, home centers, general merchandise stores, and drugstores. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

352A.summary_en: LOIVE Co.,Ltd. operates fitness studios in Japan. The company operates women yoga studio under the LOIVE brand; surf exercise studio under the Surf Fit brand; machine pilates studio under the Pilates K brand; and group machine muscle training studio under the REDY'SGYM brand name. It also provides burn-off drink under the Burn&fit brand; intestinal environment regulation tablet under the Bio&fit brand; and soy protein for adult women under the &fitPROTEIN brand. LOIVE Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as LIFE CREATE Co., Ltd. and changed its name to LOIVE Co.,Ltd. in August 2025. LOIVE Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Sapporo, Japan.

350A.summary_en: DIGITAL GRID Corporation operates power trading platform in Japan. It operates through three Segments: the Electricity PF business; Renewable energy PF business; and the Others. The company offers Digital Grid Platform, a trading platform where users can procure electricity; Econohashi, for environmental value purchasing; RE Bridge, a virtual PPA auction site; Digital Grip Platform Battery Aggregation; and GX Navi, a practical GX human resource development service for decarbonization beginners. It also engages in the balancing power business and decarbonization education business. DIGITAL GRID Corporation was founded in 2017 and is based in Minato, Japan.

343A.summary_en: IACE TRAVEL Corporation., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the travel business in Japan, Canada, and Mexico. The company offers business travel management (BTM) services, such as visa application assistance, expense settlement assistance, crisis management, and provision of travel data.It also operates Smart BTMJ, a cloud-based travel booking system with online reservation functionality that provides data analysis and proposals for cost reduction, multiple route suggestions, urgent booking arrangements, and a 24/7 emergency response system. In addition, the company provides personal travel services comprising domestic and international package tours, personal travel arrangements, custom travel proposals, and other benefits-related services; travel agency support services for government bodies, such as personal trips and home visits; airline ticketing, travel planning, and guided tours for U.S. military personnel based in Japan; flight bookings to Japan and international tours departing from Canada; and incentive travel and personal travel support for employees of Japanese corporations in Mexico. It serves corporate clients, individual travelers, government agencies, and the U.S. military in Japan. IACE TRAVEL Corporation. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

340A.summary_en: zig-zag,Inc., a technology company, provides cross-border e-commerce platform services. It offers WorldShopping, a purchasing agent service for overseas customers; and WorldShoppingBIZ, a cross-border e-commerce support service for domestic e-commerce sites. zig-zag,Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.

341A.summary_en: TOYOKOH Inc. operates as a painting and waterproofing contractor in Japan. The company offers SOSEI, a spray-coating three layers of special resin to restore strong roofs; and CoolLaser, a laser-based system for removing rust and pain from aging infrastructure. It offers waterproofing, insulation and reinforcement work for roofs; and paint and rust removal services. TOYOKOH Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Fuji, Japan.

339A.summary_en: Progress Technologies Group, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides solutions and services for the manufacturing industry in Japan. The company offers consulting and digital engineering services. It is also involved in undertaking product development; and research and development products, such as joint research and development, and contract development and design development. In addition, the company provides support product development; and design and development, and consulting and digitalization in the design and development field. Further, it offers formulation of product development designs, system designing, tool implementation support, operational familiarization, stabilization, and execution services for implementing those designs; virtual testing environments, development and evaluation of plant models, and proposal of plans for reforming the development process; and engineering services. The company was formerly known as PTS HD Inc. and changed its name to Progress Technologies Group, Inc. in February 2023. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

338A.summary_en: ZenmuTech, Inc. provides information security solutions in Japan. The company offers ZENMU Virtual Drive, a software that harnesses secret-sharing technology to enable secure and effortless PC usage; ZENMU Engine (SDK) for data protection and authentication purposes; and QueryAhead, a secure computation database platform that brings security and change to society. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

336A.summary_en: Dynamic Map Platform Co., Ltd. develops high-precision 3D data in Japan and the United States of America. The company provides Dynamic Map Platform, an autonomous driving and advance driving assistance systems for mobility; 3Dmapspocket, a data platform that allows users to view and analyze high-precision 3D point cloud data of nationwide expressways/motorways, and arterial roads; high-precision guidance using HD map generation technology; and location information services. The company was formerly known as Dynamic Map Planning Co., Ltd and changed its name to Dynamic Map Platform Co., Ltd. in June 2017. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

334A.summary_en: Visual Processing Japan Co., Ltd. engages in the development of digital asset management (DAM) solutions in Japan. The company offers DAM solution to support the business activities of companies by providing assistance on media content production, management and distribution. It provides CIERTO that integrates digital asset management and product information management to support the production of content across various platforms, such as e-commerce sites, websites, videos, social media, catalogs, and brochures; APROOOVE WM, a project management solution for content production such as catalogs, brochures, videos, and websites; and WoodWing Studio, an online editing and distribution system that enables online editing of media consisting of magazines, newspapers, and documents. The company serves distribution and retail, manufacturing, service, printing, housing and real estate, media and publishing, pharmaceutical and chemical, finance and insurance, and travelling and sightseeing industries. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
